LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MoeLotlBloodline.label: (Raven) Moe-Lotl Bloodline (Lesser)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MoeLotlBloodline.descriptio:
A cultivation bloodline branch from the Moe-Lotl. It allows the bearer to sense spiritual energy, clearing the mind and slightly improving learning speed.

Effects:
- Unlocks the cultivation panel
- Global learning speed +10%
